keyword.en: electric 30 vs low pressure 40 concrete pump
keyword.zh: 电动30和电动低压40的区别

title.zh: 电动30和电动低压40混凝土泵有何不同

description.en: These two Xingtai rows share 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa, a 0.3 m³ hopper and the same outline, then diverge on motor and distance.
description.zh: 这两行邢台参数在 12–15 m³/h、20 MPa、0.3 m³ 料斗和外形上相同，电机和距离不同。

h1.zh: 电动30和电动低压40混凝土泵有何不同

directAnswer.en: Electric 30 and Electric Low Pressure 40 are Hebei Pinjin Machinery concrete pumps in Xingtai. Both print 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa, a 0.3 m³ hopper, 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm and 1200 kg. Electric 30 prints a 30 kW motor and two stone-distance rows. Low Pressure 40 prints 37 kW, fine-stone 80 m / 240 m and a Kawasaki 112, with no aggregate-size row.
directAnswer.zh: 电动30和电动低压40是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。两边都印 12–15 m³/h、20 MPa、料斗 0.3 m³、外形 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm、1200 kg。电动30印 30 kW 和两行骨料距离。低压40印 37 kW、细石 80 m / 240 m 和川崎112，没有骨料粒径行。

heading.en: Where Electric 30 and Electric Low Pressure 40 print different values
heading.zh: 电动30和电动低压40哪些数值不同

body.en: Motor power: Electric 30 prints 30 kW; Electric Low Pressure 40 prints 37 kW. Fine-stone pumping (H / V): Electric 30 prints 60 m / 180 m; Electric Low Pressure 40 prints 80 m / 240 m. The same printed value on a shared label: Theoretical output is 12–15 m³/h on both pages; Max. outlet pressure is 20 MPa on both pages; Hopper capacity is 0.3 m³ on both pages. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 电机功率：电动30印 30 kW；电动低压40印 37 kW。细石输送（水平/垂直）：电动30印 60 m / 180 m；电动低压40印 80 m / 240 m。同一标题下数值相同的有：理论输送量两边都是 12–15 m³/h；最大出口压力两边都是 20 MPa；料斗容积两边都是 0.3 m³。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: Electric 30 prints cells that Electric Low Pressure 40 does not: Aggregate-13 pumping (H / V) 20 m / 60 m; Max. aggregate size ≤ 3 cm. Electric Low Pressure 40 prints cells that Electric 30 does not: Hydraulic pump Kawasaki 112. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: 电动30有、电动低压40没有的行：13骨料输送（水平/垂直） 20 m / 60 m；最大骨料粒径 ≤ 3 cm。电动低压40有、电动30没有的行：液压泵 Kawasaki 112。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: The words low pressure in the name do not replace the 20 MPa cell, which matches Electric 30. Open /en/products/electric-30-concrete-pump/ for Electric 30 and /en/products/electric-low-pressure-40-concrete-pump/ for Electric Low Pressure 40. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 名称里的「低压」不能代替 20 MPa 这一格，这一格与电动30相同。看电动30请打开 /zh/products/electric-30-concrete-pump/，看电动低压40请打开 /zh/products/electric-low-pressure-40-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Electric 30 print the same motor power as Electric Low Pressure 40?
question.zh: 电动30和电动低压40的电机功率一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 30 prints 30 kW. Electric Low Pressure 40 prints 37 kW. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动30印 30 kW。电动低压40印 37 kW。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric 30 print the same fine-stone pumping (h / v) as Electric Low Pressure 40?
question.zh: 电动30和电动低压40的细石输送（水平/垂直）一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 30 prints 60 m / 180 m. Electric Low Pressure 40 prints 80 m / 240 m. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动30印 60 m / 180 m。电动低压40印 80 m / 240 m。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Why is aggregate-13 pumping (h / v) missing on Electric Low Pressure 40?
question.zh: 为什么电动低压40没有13骨料输送（水平/垂直）？

answer.en: The Electric Low Pressure 40 page does not print that label. Electric 30 prints 20 m / 60 m. Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
answer.zh: 电动低压40这一页没有印这个标题。电动30印的是 20 m / 60 m。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。

question.en: Where is the hydraulic pump for Electric Low Pressure 40 printed?
question.zh: 电动低压40的液压泵印在哪里？

answer.en: It is printed on /en/products/electric-low-pressure-40-concrete-pump/ as Kawasaki 112. It is not printed as that label on the Electric 30 page.
answer.zh: 印在 /zh/products/electric-low-pressure-40-concrete-pump/，数值为 Kawasaki 112。电动30页面没有这个标题。
